decoded.meaning: NAME{"up"} — RFC-0014 §2 `remove-via-NAME`: written to /net/<module>/conn it retires /net/<module>/up
decoded.note: Create and remove collapse onto ONE control vertex and are told apart by the written TLV's TYPE — SPEC creates, NAME removes. There is no verb, no field and no DELETE opcode: removal is an ordinary WRITE (0x02) of these six bytes. The same bytes written to any vertex that is NOT a creator endpoint are an ordinary value write, not control (RFC-0014 §2, last bullet).
